<thought>To find the appropriate SN2 retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide (e.g., C‑Cl) and form a C‑N bond (amine). This matches the described forward SN2 transformation. Once a suitable template is found, I will verify it matches the target molecule and then return its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
